async def act(page):
    # Search for 'master' in the target branch dropdown searchbox
    await page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Search branches').fill('master')
    # Click the 'master' branch link
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='master').click()
    # Click to compare branches and continue
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Compare branches and continue').click()
